<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915384_theRebbe_69" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915384_theRebbe_69__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the rest of Shabbat is from You (Atah) itself, because the revelation of the aspect of the completeness of all, above the lines in all four levels, is specifically in the level of Yechidah, which is above the entire chain of descent and even above the encompassing light of the house, and therefore the rest is from You itself.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is “From You is their rest,”</t>
    <t s="1">that the rest of Shabbat is from You itself,</t>
    <t s="2">for the revelation of the aspect of the completeness of all, which is above the lines in all four levels mentioned above</t>
    <t s="3">(even from the lines as they are before the tzimtzum,</t>
    <t s="4">from You itself),</t>
    <t s="5">is specifically in the aspect of Yechidah.</t>
    <t s="6">For behold, the four aspects Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah, Chayah are in the four worlds Atzilut, Beriah, Yetzirah, Asiyah,</t>
    <t s="7">and higher than that—in the four levels of the totality of the chain of descent</t>
    <t s="8">(beginning from before the tzimtzum)</t>
    <t s="9">—but not so the aspect of Yechidah, which is above the chain of descent</t>
    <t s="10">(in man),</t>
    <t s="11">and even to the point that it is above also the aspect of the encompassing light of the house</t>
    <t s="12">[for in many places</t>
    <t s="13">it is explained that the aspect of Chayah is analogous to the encompassing light of a garment, and the aspect of Yechidah is analogous to the encompassing light of a house.</t>
    <t s="14">But in the discourse “Atah Echad” mentioned above</t>
    <t s="15">(and likewise in many places),</t>
    <t s="16">the aspect of Yechidah is above even the encompassing light of the house.</t>
    <t s="17">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="18">even in the house</t>
    <t s="19">(which is a more encompassing [light] than the encompassing light of garments)</t>
    <t s="20">the aspect of Yechidah does not dwell,</t>
    <t s="21">but rather in the four cubits that are utterly distant,</t>
    <t s="22">more than the distance of the house,</t>
    <t s="23">there specifically dwells the illumination of the aspect of Yechidah].</t>
    <t s="24">And therefore,</t>
    <t s="25">specifically in the aspect of Yechidah is the revelation of the aspect of Ein Sof</t>
    <t s="26">(which is above even the Chesed, Gevurah, Tiferet that are before the tzimtzum).</t>
    <t s="27">And this is “For from You is their rest,”</t>
    <t s="28">for since their rest</t>
    <t s="29">(of Shabbat)</t>
    <t s="30">is from the aspect of Yechidah,</t>
    <t s="31">therefore it is from You,</t>
    <t s="32">from You itself.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the Men of the Great Assembly instituted saying “Atah Echad,” and the power to draw down all four levels, even from before the tzimtzum, is given to all Jewish souls because their root is in Ein Sof itself, manifesting through the Yechidah within them, even compelling God, as it were.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And it is explained in the discourse there,</t>
    <t s="2">that what the Men of the Great Assembly instituted to say “Atah Echad,” etc.,</t>
    <t s="3">is,</t>
    <t s="4">that the Great Assembly is the Congregation of Israel,</t>
    <t s="5">and the totality of the entire chain of descent</t>
    <t s="6">(in the four levels mentioned above that are included in this formulation)</t>
    <t s="7">was given over to the Great Assembly</t>
    <t s="8">(the Congregation of Israel),</t>
    <t s="9">and from the Great Assembly</t>
    <t s="10">(the Congregation of Israel)</t>
    <t s="11">it was given over to the totality of the souls of Israel,</t>
    <t s="12">the souls that are in bodies,</t>
    <t s="13">so that they too can say and draw down all these aspects,</t>
    <t s="14">beginning from the aspect of “Atah Echad” which refers</t>
    <t s="15">(as above)</t>
    <t s="16">to the aspect of Chesed that is before the tzimtzum,</t>
    <t s="17">the aspect of the nature of the good to do good, from the desire for kindness.</t>
    <t s="18">And this is “And you shall make them,”</t>
    <t s="19">do not read “them” but “you,” as if you have made Me,</t>
    <t s="20">meaning coercion,</t>
    <t s="21">(for the meaning of “made Me” in the Holy Tongue is a matter of coercion, like a coerced get),</t>
    <t s="22">that is, you coerce Me, as it were, to be called by the name Chesed, Gevurah, Tiferet even in the aspect of Ein Sof that is before the tzimtzum.</t>
    <t s="23">And the power for this in the souls of Israel is because the root of the souls is in Ein Sof itself</t>
    <t s="24">(which is above even the Chesed, Gevurah, Tiferet that are in Ein Sof),</t>
    <t s="25">and even after they are clothed in bodies, this aspect shines in them in the aspect of Yechidah within them</t>
    <t s="26">(as above),</t>
    <t s="27">and therefore they have the power to make</t>
    <t s="28">(and in a manner of coercion)</t>
    <t s="29">all four levels mentioned above.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the discourse “Atah Echad” was said on Shabbat before Minchah, because the drawing down of the four levels through Torah, specifically the inner dimension of Torah (Chassidus), which is the Yechidah of Torah, preceded the recitation of “Atah Echad” in prayer.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And based on all the above, it will be understood why the delivery of the discourse “Atah Echad” was on Shabbat Kodesh</t>
    <t s="2">(Parshat Vayeitzei)</t>
    <t s="3">before the Minchah prayer</t>
    <t s="4">[even though generally,</t>
    <t s="5">the delivery of Chassidic discourse in the time of the ratzon deratzon is,</t>
    <t s="6">as seen by our Nesi’im,</t>
    <t s="7">after the Minchah prayer],</t>
    <t s="8">for saying “Atah Echad,” etc., is to effect the drawing down of the four levels mentioned above.</t>
    <t s="9">And since all matters are drawn down through Torah,</t>
    <t s="10">therefore,</t>
    <t s="11">before the recitation of “Atah Echad” in the Minchah prayer, there was a drawing down of this matter in Torah.</t>
    <t s="12">And since the drawing down of the four levels in the formulation of “Atah Echad” is from the root of the souls in Ein Sof that is revealed in the aspect of Yechidah, as above,</t>
    <t s="13">therefore,</t>
    <t s="14">in the Torah itself,</t>
    <t s="15">there was a drawing down of this matter as it is in the inner dimension of Torah,</t>
    <t s="16">and just as the inner dimension of Torah is in the manner of “they shall be sustained”</t>
    <t s="17">[Chassidus Chabad],</t>
    <t s="18">the aspect of Yechidah of Torah.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
